The Mexican Navy now leads citizen trust in Nuevo Laredo, reaching its highest point of the year in the latest national urban security survey, according to El Mañana. In results for September from INEGI's Encuesta Nacional de Seguridad Pública Urbana (ENSU), covering the third quarter of 2026, the Secretaría de Marina recorded 90.5% combined trust among Nuevo Laredo residents — about nine in ten residents.

The Navy finished ahead of the Mexican Army at 86.8%, the Mexican Air Force at 86.3%, and the National Guard at 83.1%. The 90.5% figure was the Navy's highest of the year, up from 87.6% in June. The Navy also led on perceived operational effectiveness in the city at 88.6%, which El Mañana reported was its first-place position for a third consecutive period.

Sources: El Mañana, “Secretaría de Marina alcanza su punto más alto de confianza en Nuevo Laredo,” Oct. 24, 2026; INEGI, ENSU, third quarter 2026 (September results).

title: Navy leads citizen trust in Nuevo Laredo, hitting its high for the year
